name: W.H. Brady & Company Limited
summary: W.H. Brady & Co. Ltd. operates as a holding company with a varied portfolio of businesses. Its activities encompass the distribution of material handling machinery, manufacturing processes, offering support services to the aviation industry, dealing in general engineering products, and leasing properties. The company organizes its operations across three main segments: Rental services, Trading, and a combined Manufacturing and Entertainment division. Established in 1895, this company is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
